scope.consumer: Existing INI_SET unpack of a named zero-argument BYREF Generator in a direct CV, with at most two copied scalar sends and an integer final key.
scope.behavior: A local yielded cell may be the CLOSED Generator's sole cached child after its input CV is rebound. With DATA as the last Generator owner, normal completion uses the existing 355 storage pin to release the scalar cell before API reception. Quiet terminal throw discards the popped CONFIG marker and the driver prunes the same cell and Generator before catch. Copied arguments, selected callee and supplied Throwable remain historical, and a weak NULL-option handler runs after both deaths.
scope.limits: Final cell must be ordinary live nondebt scalar storage and the Generator's only child; its sole owner is the Generator. Final RETURN is absent or implicit NULL, final key is integer, and producer is direct-CV BYREF. Typed/backed/owning cells, owning RETURN, noninteger final keys, temporary or Aggregate reference producers, effectful cleanup, delegation and wider lifetimes remain separate.
